name: Dak Ke Lake
kicker: The best-known lake on the plateau
summary: Walk the shore of Dak Ke, the lake Vietnam Tourism treats as the famous one in Mang Den. Canoeing, fishing, and a nhà rông are on that description. The gate fee and any boat price are Check on arrival. Skip it if you only have time for Pa Sy.
getThere: Short drive from Mang Den town
heroCaption: An old boat on Dak Ke lake, under blossom branches

notice.title: This lake is not the Pa Sy ticket
notice.body: Pa Sy is a separate gate, about 9 km from town. Dak Ke’s own fee is Check on arrival.

body: Walk the shore while the water is still. Vietnam Tourism names canoeing and fishing where they are offered, and a traditional nhà rông beside the lake. The frame you see first is an old boat under the branches. How long the shore takes is Check on arrival.

Come in the morning if you want the calm hour. Vietnam Tourism pitches cloud hunting at dawn on the plateau and does not print a lake season of its own. Skip the lake when Pa Sy already has the day. Do not treat every lake name on a blog as a second ticketed gate.

Toong Dam is the other lake Vietnam Tourism names, a quiet shore of old trees. Its fee is Check on arrival, the same as Dak Ke. The smaller Dak Ke waterfall sits nearer the lake than Pa Sy does. Vietnam Tourism says you can swim once you reach it, and that the signs are poor. The fall’s fee is Check on arrival.

figures.caption: Blossom branches over Dak Ke lake
figures.alt: Pink blossom branches in front of the green water of Dak Ke lake

gettingThere: Dak Ke is in the Mang Den ecotourism area, a short drive from the town strip. Vietnam Tourism does not print the minutes or a fare. Check on arrival. Pa Sy, the ticketed fall, is a different stop about 9 km from town.

legs.heading: From Mang Den town
legs.body: By car or motorbike. Vietnam Tourism calls it a short drive and does not print the minutes. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Kon Tum city
legs.body: Vietnam Tourism puts Mang Den about 60 km northeast of Kon Tum city on Highway 24. The lake is a further short drive from town. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Vietnam Tourism does not print a lake ticket, a child rule, or a boat price. Check on arrival. Do not budget the Pa Sy gate as this lake. The Mang Den portal of Quảng Ngãi sets Pa Sy adults at 50,000 VND and children at 25,000 VND from 30 May 2026. Việt Úc Tourist still prints 20,000 VND for that fall.
